aboutHtml:
Alastair and Louise Thomson own STIHL SHOP Porirua. We sell STIHL tools online and in our store, and we also stock Hansa, Masport, Rover, Cub Cadet, Honda Power Equipment, Walker, and Hustler. Visit us or shop online to find the right tool for your job.

Our workshop keeps your equipment in great working condition for years to come. We service STIHL and all our stocked brands, as well as Husqvarna, Shindaiwa, Echo, and Morrison. Regular servicing preserves what matters most: reliable performance and longevity. Our trained team has the expertise to work on any of these brands.

We're proud to support local organisations including Hutt High School Water Polo, HOBM Rugby, St Patricks Silverstream, Hutt International Boys School, and the Upper Hutt Axemens Club. Visit us at 6 Semple Street, Elsdon.
